name: CySOC_DCSync_UpdateWhitelist
author: CySOC
description: Add the user+host pair(s) of a DCSync case to the whitelist stored in Consul KV and close the case as a false positive. Stable identifiers (Microsoft Defender device id, directory object id) are read from the MicrosoftDefender enrichment analyzer reports attached to the observables, so different spellings of the same user/host never create duplicate entries. Fails when an observable lacks enrichment. Run by the analyst when a true positive is rejected at the final verification step. The added/refreshed pairs and the closure are logged to a 'CySOC/Log' task on the case.

configurationItems.name: thehive_api_key
configurationItems.description: TheHive API key with permission to read observables and close cases

configurationItems.name: consul_kv_whitelist
configurationItems.description: Exact Consul KV path to the whitelist key (a single key holding a YAML document, not a directory prefix)
